user.title: Deye logger over Bluetooth

data_description.live_interval: Grid phases and load. Each change is a recorder row.

data_description.allow_writes: Off: read-only. On: every setting can be changed, including grid protection and battery voltages, with no safety checks. Wrong values can damage equipment or break grid rules. Every write is read back; only changed registers are written.
